snippet.title: Project Octavia Pre-Alpha Gameplay Reveal Trailer from Twin Suns Corp!
snippet.description:
🛰️Welcome to the stylized sci-fi "spy action" video game about stealth, sabotage, gunplay, and hand-to-hand combat. Set in the alternate history world of the 1969 Cold War, a mysterious extraterrestrial material has reached Earth and changed it forever.

💥This objective-based multiplayer stealth action game allows teams of trios, duos or solos to sneak and gather intel while taking down NPC guards as well as other players all within a fully player driven creative and open sandbox of gameplay!

🥳Project Octavia was built by veteran game developers with decades of experience from franchises like Star War, Halo, Tomb Raider, Hitman, Horizon and Elder Scrolls as well as Indie Games legends and amazing new game dev. talent!

🎮**Pre-Alpha footage taken from nearly 100% real playtests!

❤️Wishlist the game on STEAM NOW!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941770/Project_Octavia/

🕵️More info: https://www.twinsunscorp.net/projectoctavia

🫂Team credits: https://www.twinsunscorp.net/projectoctavia/octaviacredits

📺Regular Developer Twitch Streams: https://www.twitch.tv/twinsunscorp

💬Discord: https://discord.gg/echfGuqTnH

🦋Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/twinsunscorp.bsky.social

🔗LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/twinsunscorp
